messages:
Maria Chen: Heads up — we need to transfer image ownership for the runtime base images and cut over to the new minimal build. This touches RBAC for builders, KMS signing keys, and audit logging. Can we align on the plan?

Ajay Patel: +1 on alignment. Quick list of questions: which service accounts will be allowed to push signed images, who holds the KMS key, and how do we want audit retention?

Sophia Liu: For builders I'd like strict least-privilege: a short-lived builder SA that can push to the repo and invoke cosign, but not list other repos. We should use a dedicated KMS key per environment (staging/prod) with rotation policy.

Noah Rivera: Agree on per-env keys. Ops question: do we rotate the cosign key at cutover or after the canary is stable?

Elena Gomez: From compliance: rotate after canary passes. We need a paper trail in audit logs for key changes and image signatures. Retention should be 1 year for prod audit logs.

Maria Chen: Plan proposal: 1) Create ephemeral builder SA with narrow IAM roles 2) Add RBAC binding to image repo for that SA only 3) Configure cosign with KMS key per env 4) Run a small canary deploy with signed image 5) Rotate keys post-canary + archive old signatures. Thoughts?

Ajay Patel: Sounds good. For step 1, propose this IAM policy snippet (GCP-style):

```
roles: [
  {role: "roles/artifactregistry.writer", members: ["serviceAccount:builder-staging@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]},
  {role: "roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier", members: ["serviceAccount:builder-staging@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]}
]
```

Sophia Liu: Minor tweak: also grant "roles/resourcemanager.projectViewer" to limit discovery but not modify infra. And ensure builder SA has no list/get on other repos.

Noah Rivera: For cosign with KMS use something like:

```
COSIGN_PASSWORD="" 
cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/myproj/locations/global/keyRings/ring/cryptoKeys/cosign-key gcr.io/redwood/runtime:v3-min
```

DevSecOps Bot: NOTE: image-signing job triggered for branch "minimal-base": build-789 succeeded at 2123456799 :white_check_mark:

Elena Gomez: Audit log config: we need to ensure Cloud Audit Logs is capturing "DATA_ACCESS" for Artifact Registry and Cloud KMS Admin activities. Also export a copy to a locked GCS bucket and to the SIEM index.

Maria Chen: Regarding vulnerability triage: we'll run the normal SBOM + scanner on the new image. If any medium+ CVEs appear, triage flow: triage board -> owner assigns -> create mitigation or backport. If something blocks the canary we abort and rollback.

Ajay Patel: For rollbacks, add an automated policy in the rollout job: if canary error rate > 2% or p50 latency regress > 30% within first 5m, revert to previous signed image. Keep artifact metadata so we can trace signature -> key -> builder SA.

Sophia Liu: We should also add an ephemeral KMS key version when we sign the canary so the rotation timeline is clear. Document the manual key-rotation runbook under docs/ops/kms-rotation.

Noah Rivera: Quick incident-response note: if a signing key is compromised, revoke the key version and mark images signed by that key as untrusted in the registry. That requires a short automation: mark images with metadata tag "signed_by_revoked_key" and block deploys by policy. Who owns that automation? @Elena?

Elena Gomez: I'll take automation ownership. Will add a small lambda that marks metadata + triggers a guardrail in the deploy pipeline.

Maria Chen: Action items: @Ajay to produce exact IAM bindings and terraform snippet by EOD, @Sophia to add rollout thresholds to the canary job, @Noah to update cosign pipeline with per-env key URL, @Elena to author the key-compromise automation playbook and audit export config.

Ajay Patel: I'll push the IAM tf in a PR and tag you all.

DevSecOps Bot: PR opened: infra/iam/PR#342 by ajay (contains builder SA + roles) — CI passed.

Sophia Liu: I'll add the canary checks to the pipeline tomorrow AM.

Noah Rivera: Cosign pipeline updated in staging. Testing signing + verify succeeded.

Elena Gomez: Draft playbook pushed to docs/incident/kms-compromise.md — requesting review.

Maria Chen: Great work. Let's meet 30m tomorrow to verify the canary and, if green, schedule key rotation window. :thumbsup:

Noah Rivera: Thanks all — tagging @oncall-security for visibility.

DevSecOps Bot: oncall-security notified.
